changeinfo.changes: - Fixed strict rules setting not applying correctly in an online session - Added corner cutting rules setting to the session list and lobby
- Increased the severity of the strict rules - Various multiplayer bug fixes
- Added a multiplayer session list - Added session progress info into multiplayer lobbies - Updated the relative performance of the teams and drivers - Various other bug fixes and improvements

- Fixed some cars not being shown a blue flag when being lapped - Fixed incorrect speech being played on the results screen - Fixed some instances of cars getting stuck in the pit lane - Added push to talk functionality for voice comms - Added notifications for players retiring during a multiplayer session - Various other bug fixes and improvements
- Introduced faster hopper matching system - Introduced invite-only sessions - Additional bug fixes and improvements

- Addition of the OSD Game Swipe feature which shows in-race information about pit strategy, fuel status, car damage and car maintenance. - Addition of on-screen information showing who is in the session and who we’re still waiting for - General bug fixes and improvements
- Introduction of the Manor Marussia F1 Team - Updated 2015 car models and handling data - Improved voice recognition - General bug fixes and improvements
